By Cauchy-Schwarz,
\[
\left(\frac1m+\frac3n\right)(3m+n)\ge \left(\sqrt{\frac1m\cdot 3m}+\sqrt{\frac3n\cdot n}\right)^2
=(\sqrt3+\sqrt3)^2=12.
\]
Since \(3m+n=1\), we get
\[
\frac1m+\frac3n\ge 12.
\]
Equality occurs when \(n=3m\), so with \(3m+n=1\): \(m=\frac16,\ n=\frac12\). Thus the minimum value is

\[
\boxed{12}.
\]
